body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「你要做一個 agent，會規劃、搜尋、呼叫工具和修訂答案，直到它覺得任務完成。你會如何避免它無限循環或在不夠證據時假裝完成？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「設定最多十次 iteration，超過就停止。」

## 次數上限不是完成定義

Iteration cap 可以限制成本和失控時間，卻不能說明 agent 為何可以交付。一個 agent 可能第一步已符合 acceptance criteria，也可能十步後仍在重複搜尋同一個缺失來源。真正要先定義的是 state 和 terminal states：completed_with_evidence、blocked_missing_input、blocked_no_permitted_source、policy_denied、budget_exceeded、retryable_failure、needs_human_review、cancelled。每一個終點要有可檢查的進入條件、留下的 artefact 和下一位 owner，而不是只有一段「我已完成」的文字。

把 agent 看成受控 state machine：每輪讀取 current state、判斷可用 transition、檢查工具 precondition、執行一個 bounded step、驗證 postcondition，再選下一步或終止。規劃不是無限的思考鏈；它是能被 trace 到 input、policy、tool call、result、budget 和 reason 的狀態變更。若同一個 query、錯誤或缺少的欄位已出現多次而沒有新證據，progress rule 應令它停下來，整理 handoff packet，而非換句 prompt 再試。

## 一鍋湯要有完成條件，唔係攪十次

煮湯時「再試味」不是一個完整做法。你要知道何時鹽量已達標、沒有材料時找誰、爐火壞了要不要停止，以及客人對某些材料過敏時絕不能繼續加。十次攪拌只是限制，不是食譜的完成條件。

## 答案在哪裡會變薄

不要一開始做 planner、reflection、browser、memory 和多個工具的自治系統。第一個 baseline 可以是：一個固定 task、一次讀取工具、一次草稿、沒有寫入或外發 action，然後由人驗收。只有 trace 顯示某個可重複 failure 需要下一步，才加入一個 state 或 tool。若產品的真實工作只是整理一份已批准的資料包，可能根本不需要 agent loop。

## 技術判斷：終止條件要可執行

為每個 terminal state 寫 acceptance predicate。例如 completed_with_evidence 要求所有必需 source IDs 已獲准、輸出通過 schema 和 citation validation、沒有 outstanding action；blocked_missing_input 要列缺失欄位和請求對象；budget_exceeded 要列已花 token／時間／工具次數、最後有效 checkpoint 和不可自動繼續的理由；needs_human_review 要附決策問題、選項和 evidence receipt。把 budget 拆成 token、time、tool calls、retry 和可造成後果 action 的 cap，因為它們代表不同風險。

用 deterministic simulation 測 state transition：工具回傳空結果、重覆結果、429、未授權、衝突 evidence、schema failure、使用者取消。測試 expected final state、trace、handoff fields 和是否有任何不應發生的 action。不要只測順利完成的一條路。

## 工程層面：把每個工具 call 當成一份合約

每個 tool 宣告 allowed state、input schema、permission／scope、timeout、retry class、預期 postcondition 和失敗轉向。controller 在發出 call 前重新檢查 budget 和 policy，不把這些責任交給模型自行記住。保留 event log：run ID、state transition、tool name、輸入摘要、result reference、model／prompt version、cost／time 和 stop reason；敏感內容以最小化 receipt 或 fixture 代替。

人手交接不是 agent 失敗的垃圾桶。handoff packet 應可讓下一位人知道：它做到哪一步、何處卡住、已排除甚麼、甚麼 action 未做、要問誰和要取得甚麼批准。沒有這些資訊，停止只會把成本轉移給 support。

## 交付、業務與風險：自主程度要配合後果

產品 owner 要定義「完成」對使用者有甚麼可驗收含義；流程 owner 要擁有 blocked state 的處理；安全／資料 owner 要決定 policy_denied 不可被 agent 繞過。量度 completion-with-evidence rate、每個 terminal state 的比例、無進展 loop、handoff turnaround、budget burn 和錯誤自動 action 的零容忍事件。不要用總步數或聊天長度代替真正的交付品質。

## 可放進 portfolio 的 artefact

建立 bounded-agent-state-machine-lab：

- docs/state-machine.md：state、transition、terminal predicate、owner 和不可做 action。
- fixtures/runs.json：完全合成的 success、no-source、conflict、tool-timeout、repeated-result 和 cancellation run。
- tests/terminal-state-matrix.md：每個 run 的 expected stop state、evidence receipt、budget summary 和 handoff。
- docs/tool-contracts.md：每個 tool 的 precondition、scope、retry class 和 postcondition。
- docs/decision-record.md：為何 first release 只做單工具 draft，哪項 trace 證據才允許加一個 loop。

## 延伸閱讀

[Agent draft 不作有後果 action](/zh-HK/interview-lab/agent-draft-without-consequential-actions)、[retry 不是 recovery plan](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-retry-is-not-a-recovery-plan) 和 [從需求到驗收](/zh-HK/articles/from-vague-request-to-accepted-feature)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。state、工具、run、資料和結果均為 synthetic draft fixture；它不是任何公司 agent、已部署自動化、成本表現或商業結果的描述。

body.zh-Hans:
> 面试官问：“你要做一个 agent，会规划、搜索、调用工具和修订答案，直到它觉得任务完成。你会如何避免它无限循环，或在证据不足时假装完成？”
>
> 答对一半的回答：“设置最多十次 iteration，超过就停止。”

## 次数上限不是完成定义

Iteration cap 能限制成本和失控时间，却不能说明 agent 为什么可以交付。一个 agent 可能第一步已符合 acceptance criteria，也可能十步后仍重复搜索同一个缺失来源。真正首先要定义的是 state 和 terminal states：completed_with_evidence、blocked_missing_input、blocked_no_permitted_source、policy_denied、budget_exceeded、retryable_failure、needs_human_review、cancelled。每个终点都要有可检查的进入条件、留下的 artefact 和下一位 owner，而不是一句“我已完成”。

将 agent 当作受控 state machine：每轮读取 current state、判断可用 transition、检查工具 precondition、执行一个 bounded step、验证 postcondition，再选择下一步或终止。规划不是无限思考链；它是能 trace 到 input、policy、tool call、result、budget 和 reason 的状态变化。若同一个 query、错误或缺失字段出现多次却没有新证据，progress rule 应让它停下、整理 handoff packet，而不是换一句 prompt 再试。

## 一锅汤要有完成条件，不是搅十次

煮汤时“再尝尝”不是完整做法。你要知道何时盐量达标、没有材料时找谁、炉火坏了要不要停，以及客人对某些材料过敏时绝不能继续加。十次搅拌只是限制，不是菜谱的完成条件。

## 答案容易在哪儿变薄

不要一开始做 planner、reflection、browser、memory 和多工具自治系统。第一个 baseline 可以是：一个固定 task、一次读取工具、一次草稿、没有写入或外发 action，再由人验收。只有 trace 显示某个可重复 failure 确实需要下一步，才加入一个 state 或 tool。若真实工作只是整理已批准资料包，可能根本不需要 agent loop。

## 技术判断：终止条件必须可执行

为每个 terminal state 写 acceptance predicate。例如 completed_with_evidence 要求必要 source IDs 已获准、输出通过 schema 与 citation validation、没有 outstanding action；blocked_missing_input 列出缺失字段和请求对象；budget_exceeded 列出已用 token／时间／工具次数、最后有效 checkpoint 和不可自动继续原因；needs_human_review 附决策问题、选项和 evidence receipt。将 budget 拆为 token、time、tool calls、retry 和可能造成后果 action 的 cap，因为它们代表不同风险。

使用 deterministic simulation 测 state transition：工具返回空结果、重复结果、429、未授权、冲突 evidence、schema failure、用户取消。测试 expected final state、trace、handoff fields 和任何不应发生的 action。不要只测试顺利完成的路径。

## 工程层面：每个工具 call 都是一份合约

每个 tool 声明 allowed state、input schema、permission／scope、timeout、retry class、预期 postcondition 和失败转向。controller 在发出 call 前重新检查 budget 与 policy，不把这些责任交给模型自己记住。保留 event log：run ID、state transition、tool name、输入摘要、result reference、model／prompt version、cost／time 和 stop reason；敏感内容以最小 receipt 或 fixture 代替。

人工交接不是 agent 失败的垃圾桶。handoff packet 要让下一位知道：做到哪一步、卡在哪里、已排除什么、什么 action 没做、该问谁和该获得什么批准。没有这些信息，停止只会把成本转给 support。

## 交付、业务与风险：自主程度要配合后果

产品 owner 要定义“完成”对用户的可验收含义；流程 owner 要拥有 blocked state 的处理；安全／数据 owner 要确认 policy_denied 不能被 agent 绕过。量度 completion-with-evidence rate、各 terminal state 比例、无进展 loop、handoff turnaround、budget burn 和错误自动 action 的零容忍事件。不要用总步数或聊天长度代替交付质量。

## 可放进 portfolio 的 artefact

建立 bounded-agent-state-machine-lab：

- docs/state-machine.md：state、transition、terminal predicate、owner 和不可做 action。
- fixtures/runs.json：完全合成的 success、no-source、conflict、tool-timeout、repeated-result 和 cancellation run。
- tests/terminal-state-matrix.md：每个 run 的 expected stop state、evidence receipt、budget summary 和 handoff。

这是 AI.DOG 的单题练习。state、工具、run、数据和结果均为 synthetic draft fixture；它不是任何公司 agent、已部署自动化、成本表现或商业结果的描述。
body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “You are building an agent that plans, searches, calls tools, and revises its answer until it thinks the task is done. How do you prevent an infinite loop or a confident completion with insufficient evidence?”
>
> Half-right answer: “Set a maximum of ten iterations and stop after that.”

## A cap is not a definition of done

An iteration cap limits cost and runaway time. It does not explain why an agent is allowed to hand work over. An agent may meet the acceptance criteria on its first step, or it may spend ten steps searching for the same missing source. First define states and terminal states: completed_with_evidence, blocked_missing_input, blocked_no_permitted_source, policy_denied, budget_exceeded, retryable_failure, needs_human_review, and cancelled. Every terminal state needs an inspectable entry condition, retained artefacts, and a next owner—not just a sentence saying “completed”.

Treat the agent as a controlled state machine. Each turn reads its current state, chooses an allowed transition, checks a tool precondition, performs one bounded step, validates the postcondition, and either selects the next step or terminates. Planning is not an unlimited chain of thought; it is a state change traceable to input, policy, tool call, result, budget, and reason. If the same query, error, or missing field occurs several times without new evidence, a progress rule should stop the run and assemble a handoff packet rather than paraphrase the prompt and try again.

## A soup needs a finish condition, not ten stirs

“Taste it again” is not a complete soup recipe. You need to know when the salt target is met, who to ask when an ingredient is missing, whether to stop when the stove fails, and what must never be added for an allergic guest. Stirring ten times is a limit, not a definition of done.

## Where an answer goes thin

Do not begin with a planner, reflection loop, browser, memory, and many autonomous tools. A first baseline can be one fixed task, one read-only tool call, one draft, no write or outbound action, and human acceptance. Add a state or tool only after a trace shows a repeatable failure that needs it. If the actual work is simply organising an approved evidence pack, it may not need an agent loop at all.

## Technical judgement: make terminal conditions executable

Write an acceptance predicate for every terminal state. For example, completed_with_evidence requires all mandatory source IDs to be permitted, the output to pass schema and citation validation, and no outstanding action. blocked_missing_input names missing fields and the requested party. budget_exceeded records tokens, time, tool calls, the last good checkpoint, and why the system must not continue automatically. needs_human_review includes the decision question, options, and evidence receipt. Split budget into token, time, tool-call, retry, and consequential-action caps because they represent different risks.

Use deterministic simulation to test transitions: a tool returns nothing, repeated results, a 429, unauthorised access, conflicting evidence, schema failure, or user cancellation. Test the expected final state, trace, handoff fields, and the absence of prohibited actions. Do not test only the happy path.

## Engineering implementation: every tool call is a contract

Each tool declares allowed state, input schema, permission and scope, timeout, retry class, expected postcondition, and failure transition. The controller rechecks budget and policy before every call; it does not rely on a model remembering them. Retain an event log of run ID, state transition, tool name, input summary, result reference, model and prompt version, cost and time, and stop reason. Use minimal receipts or fixtures in place of sensitive content.

Human handoff is not a bin for agent failure. A handoff packet should tell the next person what was completed, where it stopped, what was ruled out, which actions were not taken, who to ask, and which approval is needed. Without that, stopping merely transfers the cost to support.

## Delivery, business, and risk

A product owner defines what “done” means to a user. A process owner owns blocked states. A safety or data owner decides that policy_denied cannot be bypassed by the agent. Measure completion-with-evidence rate, the share of each terminal state, no-progress loops, handoff turnaround, budget burn, and zero-tolerance erroneous automatic actions. Total steps or chat length are not delivery quality.

## A portfolio artefact someone can inspect

Build bounded-agent-state-machine-lab with:

- docs/state-machine.md: states, transitions, terminal predicates, owners, and prohibited actions.
- fixtures/runs.json: fully synthetic success, no-source, conflict, tool-timeout, repeated-result, and cancellation runs.
- tests/terminal-state-matrix.md: expected stop state, evidence receipt, budget summary, and handoff for every run.
- docs/tool-contracts.md: each tool's precondition, scope, retry class, and postcondition.
- docs/decision-record.md: why the first release is a one-tool draft and what trace evidence would justify adding a loop.

## Further reading

[Agent drafts without consequential actions](/en/interview-lab/agent-draft-without-consequential-actions), [a retry is not a recovery plan](/en/interview-lab/a-retry-is-not-a-recovery-plan), and [move from a vague request to an accepted feature](/en/articles/from-vague-request-to-accepted-feature).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Its states, tools, runs, data, and results are synthetic draft fixtures. It is not a description of a company agent, deployed automation, cost performance, or business outcome.
